banner.title: ai-pvc
banner.tagline: Two 100 Gi CephFS claims that Hermes and Samba share, deliberately without a backup.

explainer.title: Two shared claims, no second copy

steps.title: Claim
steps.text: Two ReadWriteMany claims on ceph-filesystem-rwx: shared-files for scratch drops and shared-xml for the XML corpus.
steps.scene: two drive bays on a shared bus

steps.title: Mount
steps.text: Hermes mounts shared-xml at /opt/xml and shared-files at /opt/files. Samba exports the same two claims over SMB, and several pods can write to each at once.
steps.scene: several hands reaching into one shared folder

steps.title: Unbacked
steps.text: Neither claim has a kopiur include. The Mac holds the authoritative XML copy, and shared-files has no second copy at all.
steps.scene: a folder with no duplicate beside it
